messages.content: Generate one realistic cold-chain disruption scenario as JSON. Only emit description and disruptions. messages.content: Generate one realistic cold-chain disruption scenario as JSON. Only emit description and disruptions. kinetic_provenance.method: Zero-order additive quality budget with published endpoint rates or explicitly normative Q10 prior
model_extensions: Piecewise-linear zero-order rate interpolation of S5/S8 endpoints extends scalar Eq. (1). No curve extrapolation.
Orange uses normative 56-day/Q10=2 prior, not an independently measured batch calibration.
Published strawberry/apple Q10 values are retained as provenance; tabulated curves take precedence.
Strawberry zone 4-5 C is an experimental handling scenario, warmer than the S17 optimal 0-3 C range.
Three zone temperatures and controller constants are scenario choices, not inferred thermal calibration.
kinetic_provenance.normalization: Constant-temperature quality rate = 1 / published shelf-life hours. Interpolate reciprocal life, not life. Divide by reference rate to consume reference-life hours.

source_tables.oranges: S17 recommended shelf life and Q10; Annex II citrus paragraph anchors 4 C

pmc_provenance.semantics: Synthetic produce by slot zone; reference IDs retained only for lineage. No food observations inferred.

scenario_provenance.description: A cooling failure occurs in the cool zone disrupting the temperature control for 30 minutes starting at minute 60, causing a temperature rise of 3 degrees Celsius.

messages.content: Generate one realistic cold-chain disruption scenario as JSON. Only emit description and disruptions. Generate at least one disruption. sensor_bias value is Celsius bias added to sensor reading, between -5 and +5. cooling_failure value is available cooling fraction between 0 and 1. door_stuck value must be 1. Use only existing zone IDs. Events must fit the horizon; same kind and zone events must not overlap. Do not change stock, temperatures, products, orders or physics parameters. Schema: {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["description", "disruptions"], "properties": {"description": {"type": "string"}, "disruptions": {"type": "array", "maxItems": 8, "items": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["kind", "zone", "at_minute", "duration_minutes", "value"], "properties": {"kind": {"type": "string", "enum": ["sensor_bias", "cooling_failure", "door_stuck"]}, "zone": {"type": "string", "enum": ["chilled", "cool", "temperate"]}, "at_minute": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0}, "duration_minutes": {"type": "number", "exclusiveMinimum": 0}, "value": {"type": "number"}}}}}}
